skills.name: Grow Up Fast!
skills.description: Grows vegetables to attack. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Cancels enemy buffs   *Stuns enemies (9 sec)

skills.name: Flying High!
skills.description: Brown jumps high and launches one ally forward. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (7 sec) *Move Speed +180% (7 sec) *Send 1 ally forward

abilities.name: Resistance: Enemy Cost Increase
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability block enemies' Cost Increase Abilities.  - Affected Abilities: Enemy Cost Increase, Enemy Cost Increase 2

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback+ : Intelligence
abilities.description: Has a super high chance of knocking back all Intelligence type enemies and canceling their Skill Barrier effects when Rangers deploy.  - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 3 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Guardians, Bosses, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
